_README: Accepted findings for tools/gate-wiring.mjs. An entry here is a DECISION, not a snooze: every one needs a reason below. Anything without a written justification does not belong in this file — the gate is allowed to stay red while real defects are open.

_methods_reasons.debugPose: weapons debug-only; driven from src/weapons/preview.js harness, not gameplay
_methods_reasons.debugStage: ai capture-only; staged tableau for screenshots, invoked from the shot harness
_methods_reasons.setFromObject: physics helper used by the weapons preview harness only
_methods_reasons.patchMaterials: render internal, invoked through the material system during init
_methods_reasons.requestEnvMap: render internal, driven by the sky subsystem probe cycle

_events_reasons._none_yet: No event is allow-listed. Every orphaned emit currently reported is either an open defect (ui:pause, ai:bark, player:heartbeat) or an extension point I introduced and have not yet justified (match:end, player:respawn). Allow-listing my own orphans would be exactly the excuse this gate exists to refuse.
